plan.archetype: Frontloaded area damage transitioning into poison and dexterity scaling
plan.bossPrep: Bring area damage, reliable poison scaling, improved block and weakness. Enter healthy with useful potions; eliminate followers before their strength overwhelms defenses.
plan.summary: Prioritize immediate damage and area coverage first. Add poison scaling and dexterity-backed defense, remove Strikes, and adapt to the relic. Fight elites only after improving combat strength; preserve health for the Kin.
